steps.headline: A custom endpoint that points at this computer, like Ollama, now lists under Local Models instead of under OpenRouter.
steps.changed: Your question in chat: wouldn't Ollama be local? The app sorts each custom endpoint by its address. One on this computer (localhost) lists under Local Models, after Other local apps; one on a server elsewhere stays under Cloud Models. In round 4 the list under Other local apps was empty and Ollama sat under the OpenRouter card.
steps.notice: Add provider stays under Cloud Models. A local endpoint added there moves to Local Models the moment it is saved.
steps.risk: A local server reached by a name other than localhost (a Tailscale name, your machine's own name) would still be filed under Cloud; the address is the only signal.
